questions: The only Brazilian celebrity ever to appear on Forbes' billionaires list, this TV presenter founded the network SBT and a business empire spanning media and real estate. Who is he?
Silvio Santos: Brazilian television presenter and business magnate (1930–2024)
Bauhaus: Germany. The Bauhaus was founded by architect Walter Gropius in Weimar.
Born in Gjirokastër in 1908, this communist revolutionary unified his country's fractured movement after the Italian invasion and ruled Albania from 1944 until his death in 1985 — who was he?
Enver Hoxha (16 October 1908 - 11 April 1985) was an Albanian communist revolutionary, statesman, and political theorist who was the leader of Albania from 1944 until his death in 1985.
This Mexican former footballer, a versatile attacking player, was recruited by Barcelona at a young age and played for their B team until he was 18 before working his way up. Who is he?
Giovani dos Santos (Spanish; born 11 May 1989) is a Mexican former professional footballer.
Which of these four came first?
Braunschweig (founded 861) is the earliest of the four.
Directed by Kathryn Bigelow, this 2002 film stars Harrison Ford and Liam Neeson in a story about a Soviet Hotel-class submarine set in 1961 — which film?
K-19: The Widowmaker: 2002 film by Kathryn Bigelow. The film received mixed reviews upon release, with critics praising the performances and dramatic atmosphere, but criticizing the screenplay.
Said to have sung in her heart to the Lord as musicians played at her own wedding, this Christian virgin martyr became the patron saint of music and musicians — who was she?
Cecilia of Rome was a Christian virgin martyr, who is venerated in Roman Catholic, Eastern Orthodox, Anglican, and some Lutheran churches, such as the Church of Sweden.
